title: Keep Gram-state output and kernel/recovery claims distinct
statement: For common source Kraus K and known Pauli labels P_j, coherent windows produce(KP_j plus-or-minus P_jK)/2 without a controlled unknown source. Pure uniform label control yields H^T/18 in the minus branch; general rho yields rho Hadamard H^T/2. The complete retired instrument has the ordinary memory marginal, while selected/control-retaining outputs need not. This does not prepare a kernel state or implement H rho H.

requires: Fresh pure uniform nine-label state and trusted isolated controlled-known-Pauli windows
One common complete source map and actual memory/reference boundary across branches
Correct transpose, full plus/minus outcomes and actual control/record retirement
provides: For common source Kraus K and known Pauli labels P_j, coherent windows produce(KP_j plus-or-minus P_jK)/2 without a controlled unknown source. Pure uniform label control yields H^T/18 in the minus branch; general rho yields rho Hadamard H^T/2. The complete retired instrument has the ordinary memory marginal, while selected/control-retaining outputs need not. This does not prepare a kernel state or implement H rho H.
assumptions: A pure coherent label superposition is required; a classical uniform mixture is different. Output is neither H rho H, an inverse, a prepared kernel state nor a recovery algorithm. Direct scalar objective use gives a smaller Bernoulli signal than the ordinary positive Bell-sign probe and needs more coherent controls. The222-CNOT/398-single-gate budget is a compositional upper bound, not a full executed elementary netlist or hardware result. N1041 supplies only its actual isolated-control scope.
costs: Fresh maximally mixed source input/reference, pure label preparation, coherent controls, measurement, routing, idle/reset and privacy
For D4, compositional upper budget222 CNOT and398 singles; local controls and noise/precision still require qualification
Direct scalar probability is(4/27) times the positive-probe signal; no acquisition/recovery advantage is established
